title: Seasonal Sprint Helix: quarterly roadmap playbook for Hosted API & Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description: A playbook to align product, eng, and design around a seasonal quarterly roadmap for the Hosted API and model catalog. Uses a 'helix' cadence model that interleaves feature waves, canary windows, and capacity hedges so releases are resilient across model rotations and regional demand spikes. This ticket captures goals, timeline, milestone handoffs, and orchestration rules for cycle planning and OKR alignment.
objectives_and_key_results: O1: Reduce median 95th percentile latency variance for hosted endpoints by 15% across the model catalog — KR1: Define SLO gating per model tier; KR2: Ship batching/KV-cache tuning suggestions for top 5 request shapes
O2: Improve model availability during rotation windows — KR1: Establish canary and rollback windows; KR2: Implement automated fallback routing for 3 highest-traffic endpoints
O3: Optimize unit cost for the hosted API — KR1: Deliver Optimize-runbook suggestions that cut per-token cost for chat workloads by 8%
O4: Increase cross-team clarity on roadmap commitments — KR1: Publish Helix calendar and dependency map; KR2: Run two cross-functional cadence reviews per quarter
quarter_timeline: Week 1 (Planning): kick-off, stakeholder alignment, finalize Helix lanes and ownership
Week 2-4 (Discovery & Scoping): experiments backlog triage, perf regressions inventory, initial canary windows scheduled
Week 5-9 (Implementation Wave A): low-risk API ergonomics and console visuals; runtime gating flags prepared
Week 10 (Canary A): lightweight canary with 5% traffic, monitoring dashboards validated
Week 11-14 (Implementation Wave B): model catalog onboarding flow, model health checks, quantization guidance
Week 15 (Canary B + Capacity Hedge): 20% traffic canary with fallback routing and capacity cushion applied
Week 16-17 (Hardening): post-canary fixes, rollout automation, documentation update
Week 18 (Launch Window): full rollout to Hosted API model catalog tiers with rollback playbook
Ongoing: weekly cadence reviews, readouts to execs at mid-quarter and end-of-quarter
milestones: Helix calendar published and synced with eng resource planner (due Week 1)
Model catalog health-check APIs v1 (due Week 12)
Fallback routing + regional policy v1 (due Week 15)
Quarterly postmortem and metrics readout (due Week 18)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model rotation causes traffic spike and cache churn -> Mitigation: pre-warm KV cache for top prefixes and reserve 10% burst capacity in Dedicated pools
Risk: Canary telemetry is noisy and invisible to product -> Mitigation: standardize canary dashboards and synthetic traffic generators; require sign-off from SRE
Risk: Dependencies on infra changes slip into later cycles -> Mitigation: lock down infra API surface by week 3 and create cutover checklist
Risk: Conflicting stakeholder priorities for same runway -> Mitigation: Helix arbitration rule: safety/availability > cost > feature when conflicts arise; PM ties-breaks
